newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - June 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The news editor of a Philippine tabloid is shot dead in a stolen taxi in Manila suburb. (ALL PAPERS)
- Vice President Joseph Estrada is set to resign as the head of the Presidential Anti-Crime Commission, finally severing ties with the Ramos Administration. (MANILA TIMES)

- The Swiss government is blocking the claims of both the Philippine government and the 10,000 victims of human rights abuses under Marcos dictatorship to the $500 million Marcos Swiss assets deposited in two Swiss banks. (TODAY)

- The Department of Health says 85 to 90 percent of dengue victims nationwide are schoolchildren, thereby urging schoold officials to discourage the use of flower vases in school premises (MANILA BULLETIN)
